summary: Pull your open tasks, emails, and upcoming meetings into one view every Monday morning.

useCases.title: Create a weekly personal briefing
useCases.message: Help me set up a weekly personal briefing. If you don't already know, ask me which tools to pull from such as email, calendar, and tasks. Then set up a Routine that runs every Monday morning and sends me a digest covering my open actions, upcoming meetings, and the three things I should focus on first.
